_help: Armory economy (Skillz). currency = Gravemark: persistent (Progress [armory]), separate from points, kept on death. Every source's amount or chance is multiplied by Difficulty.rare_currency_drop_mult() (easy 1.0, medium 1.35, hard 1.75); chances above 1 pay the whole part plus a roll for the rest. match_cap = most Gravemarks one match can pay. upgrades = per-archetype tiers bought in order; cost[tier-1] x archetype_cost_mult; item_power = TOTAL bonus at that tier added to the weapon's Item Power (damage x(1+IP*0.004)); mods = that tier's extra WeaponItem mods (they stack with lower tiers). expected = assumptions for Armory.expected_match_income() / expected_match_scrap() (tests + the matches-to-max table). Economy v2 (2026-10-20, DESIGN §21): weapon upgrade tiers cost Scrap (upgrades.currency, scrap section), Gravemark stays for attachments, optics and the Merchant; Gravemark sources retuned (round trickle, chests 50%, milestones every 5, kills x2-3) so a normal Medium match pays ~13 instead of ~1.

boss._help: BossCatalog gravemark_reward (2-3) for the first boss killed in a round; later bosses that round pay extra_boss_amount.

elite._help: zombie meta 'elite' = true, or a variant listed here (none yet; G4M3N's armored variants).

chest._help: Chests cost points now (data/economy.json -> chests) and relocate after a buy, so a bought chest is a real event: 40% x drop mult, max 1 per round / 3 per match.

round._help: Economy v2: every cleared round pays `amount` x drop mult (fractions roll, see Armory.roll_count), from from_round on. The steady trickle that was missing: before v2 almost everything came from bosses and round-10 milestones most players never reached.

tiers.name: II
tiers.summary: +16 Item Power, reload -5%. Unlocks tier 2 attachments.

tiers.name: IV
tiers.summary: +38 Item Power, recoil -10%. Unlocks tier 3 attachments.

upgrades._help: currency: 'scrap' (Economy v2) or 'gravemark' (the old behaviour; costs then read gravemark_cost). cost = Scrap per tier; gravemark_cost = the pre-v2 Gravemark price, kept so currency can be switched back.

expected._help: Income model: kills = main.gd wave counts x Difficulty count mults; chest_opens_per_round (paid chests: ~1 buy every 3 rounds); bosses killed as rostered; scrap_share = share of gear pickups a player scraps. typical_rounds = where a normal match ends (v2: measured against Jason's v0.6.1 run, ~3 Gravemarks by level ~20, which the old 15 / 13 / 11 overestimated: players die around rounds 6-8 before the gentler scaling).

scrap._help: Scrap (Economy v2, save v6, /workspace/skillz/SCRAP_API.md): persistent currency (Progress [scrap]), kept on death. Earned only by scrapping gear (stash / Kit / Armory: Inventory.dismantle, Progress.scrap_item). yield[rarity] per piece, + item_power_step: +1 Scrap per that many Item Power above 100 (0 = off). Spent on Armory weapon upgrade tiers (upgrades.currency).
scrap.name: Scrap
